classified.justification: root_cause is a verbatim copy of description and names only a symptom (grad-norm range dropped across versions) with no compared objects, defect site, or fix, so the record itself cannot support deriving any relation.

The relation is expressible as an executable count predicate (one scheduler-emitted LR entry per optimizer param group) but its objects recur in no other case, so §4 holds it as a singleton rather than promoting it.

root_cause restates the title ('incomplete or incorrect') with no mechanism and no trigger conditions, leaving the fields unable to discriminate a T12 save-inventory count obligation from a T11 restored-value equality obligation.

The config-vs-constructed-module structural consistency (QK-norm size equals the dimension implied by n_kv_heads/n_heads under GQA) is a writable predicate, but it appears once and matches no frozen template's objects, so it stays a singleton.

The violated quantity is a hard-coded hardware datasheet constant whose truth lives outside the run; the training trace carries no signal witnessing a 2x-low peak, since training is unaffected and inflated MFU need not exceed 100%.
